responsibility: This machine-description fragment factors PRU ALU instruction semantics around the target’s implicit zero-extension behavior. It defines substitution attributes and reusable RTL patterns for arithmetic, logical, shift, bit-set/clear, and LMBD operations so that pru.md can generate the correct insn variants for QI/HI/SI operands with or without explicit zero_extend wrappers, while still emitting the same underlying PRU ALU instructions.
